items.html: Reiki in Cork, Ireland: a gentle, hands-on (or hands-off) energy practice for relaxation and inner balance. Sessions are calm and unhurried, and you stay fully clothed. Reiki complements, and never replaces, care from your doctor. Ask about a Reiki session.

Shamanic Reiki healing in Ireland brings together Reiki energy work and traditional shamanic practices such as drumming and journeying. Each session is shaped around what you bring on the day. Get in touch to book.

A shamanic journey in Cork is a guided inner journey, usually to the steady beat of a drum, used for reflection, insight and connection with your own inner guidance. No previous experience is needed. Ask about a journey session.

Soul retrieval in Ireland: a traditional shamanic practice that works with the feeling of having lost a part of yourself after difficult life events. It is a spiritual practice and works alongside, not instead of, professional medical or psychological support. Talk to me before booking.
Shamanic drumming in Cork: a simple, grounding meditation where a steady drum rhythm helps the mind settle and the body relax. Suitable for beginners. See upcoming drumming circles.

Shamanic counselling and coaching in Ireland combines supportive conversation with shamanic tools to help you look at a question or life change from a new angle. Available in person and online. Arrange a first conversation.

Distance healing online: if you cannot travel to Cork, Reiki and shamanic healing sessions can be held at a distance, wherever you are in Ireland or abroad. You simply rest quietly at home during the agreed time. Book a distance session.
Reiki and shamanic courses in Ireland for beginners and for those who want to go deeper, taught in small groups with plenty of time for practice and questions. See the next course dates.
Shamanism in Ireland: an introduction to one of the oldest spiritual practices, its connection with nature, and how it can be part of everyday life today. Read about becoming a shaman.

Tuning fork sound healing in Cork: a relaxing session using the vibration of tuned forks near and on the body to help you unwind. It complements, and never replaces, medical care. Ask about a session.
